result.device: GPU · NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (8.0 GB)
notes: Domain: 7.36 reference lengths upstream, 15.1 downstream and 19.6 reference lengths tall (5.1 % blockage) with frictionless walls top and bottom.

The domain was made more compact than usual to keep the cell count within the GPU budget of 250,000 cells; this costs a little accuracy (blockage, inlet proximity) but keeps the boundary layers resolved.
Grid: 540 × 450 = 243,000 cells of 0.435 mm; 23 cells per reference length (Draft quality on the GPU). Sizes are rounded to FFT-friendly numbers for the pressure solver.

Flow model: laminar at Re = 40; a laminar boundary layer is about 0.79 reference lengths thick, i.e. 18.2 cells, so no turbulence model is needed. Advection uses central differences (cell Reynolds number ≤ 2).

Duration: 60 convective times L/U (10.3 s of real flow); forces are averaged from t = 30 (or later, where the start-up transient is found to end), and the run stops early once the mean drag is known to ±5 % and the mean lift to ±10 % (one standard error) and neither drifts.
Time step ≈ 0.0054 L/U from the stability limit (CFL 0.5): about 11,188 steps, estimated 24 s on GPU · NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (8.0 GB) (calibrated estimate; refined after each run).
Heat transfer: air at 15 °C (ideal gas, Sutherland's law): Pr 0.700, k 0.0253 W/(m·K), cp 1,006 J/(kg·K), β 0.00347 1/K (prandtl as typed).
Temperature scale ΔT = 10.0 K (body “Cylinder” to ambient); the solver carries θ = (T − 15.00 °C) / ΔT.
Buoyancy off: the temperature is carried by the flow but does not move it (forced convection).
Thermal resolution: about 22 cells across the thermal boundary layers.
The placed physics costs about 57 % more time per step (measured per feature, theory_ns2d.md 20.3); the estimate includes it.
Settled: the Nusselt number ±0.027 % (one standard error).

Stopped early at t = 46.1 of 60 L/U: mean Cd known to ±0.063 % and mean Cl to ±0.0030 (targets ±5 % and ±0.083 (absolute: the mean is near zero), one standard error from batch means); no drift between the halves of the averaging window.
Forces averaged over t = 30 … 46.1 L/U.
Fluid temperature (time-averaged): mean 15.22 °C, min 15.00 °C, max 24.99 °C (ambient 15.00 °C).
Mean Nusselt number 3.341 ± 0.00089 (a rough estimate: few independent samples) over t = 30 … 46.1; heat rate 2.699 W/m.
warnings: The temperature field had not settled: 10 % of the heat put into the fluid was still being stored in it at the end (heat balance, W/m), so the Nusselt number and heat rate were still changing and their error bars understate the uncertainty. Run longer (Duration) before relying on them.

provenance.determinism: The flow computation draws no random numbers (the start-up perturbation is a fixed Lamb-Oseen vortex), so the inputs determine every field, force and heat rate; only the display positions of 3D tracer particles are random. Floating-point reductions on a GPU are not bitwise reproducible across devices or driver versions, which changes time-averaged values only within their statistical uncertainty.
